title: ^Crowned With Grace by Simeon Rich and

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: My Lord and King, I sing of Your love
You blessed me with all spiritual blessings
You alone exalt and choose where favour rests
And in Your grace Lord, You lavished it on me

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: I have tasted and seen that You are
And I’m here to tell the whole world of Your love
And of Your fullness, I’ve received
Grace for grace, my Lord and King

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: You have crowned me with Your grace and glory
Almighty God so rich in mercy
My life is the proof of what Your favour can do
You’re the definition of kindness and love
Over and over, I see Your faithfulness
Like banners of praise, my hands are raised to You

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: You qualified me to share in the glorious heritage
Son of the Most High God
The King who rules the world
From Your throne in my heart
Blessed be Your name

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: You qualified me to share in the glorious heritage
Son of the Most High God
The King who rules the world
From Your throne in my heart
Blessed be Your name
